tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Gauss--Bonnet theorem on the torus] 1. ch9:9-4↗ thm:gauss-bonnet-theorem Let $T \subseteq \mathbb {R}^3$ be the torus of revolution obtained by revolving the circle $(r - 2)^2 + z^2 = 1$ around the $z$-axis (see p. 19). Compute the Gaussian curvature of $T$ and verify the Gauss--Bonnet theorem in this case. \end{exercise}
